from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd, json
ws=Path('results/business/goodbooks_10k/task1/codex_20260618_144747/workspace')
clean=pd.read_csv(ws/'cleaned_books_analysis.csv')
init=pd.read_csv(ws/'first_review_pool.csv').head(10)['book_key'].astype(int).tolist()
rel=json.loads((ws/'relative_demand_summary.json').read_text())['relative_top10_book_keys']
exp=json.loads((ws/'exposure_aware_quality_summary.json').read_text())['exposure_aware_top10_book_keys']
from collections import Counter
cnt=Counter(init+rel+exp)
stable=[k for k,c in cnt.items() if c>=2]
print('sets', init, rel, exp)
print('stable count', len(stable), sorted((k,cnt[k]) for k in stable))
clean['early_key_count']=clean.groupby('early_title_key')['book_key'].transform('size')
clean['strict_key_count']=clean.groupby('strict_title_key')['book_key'].transform('size')
clean['strict_more_collisions']=clean['strict_key_count']>clean['early_key_count']
clean['orig_len']=clean['original_title'].astype(str).str.len()
median=clean['orig_len'].median()
print('median len', median)
clean['short']=clean['orig_len']<=median
clean['author_count']=clean['authors'].astype(str).apply(lambda s: len([p for p in s.split(',') if p.strip()]))
clean['amb']=clean['author_count']>2
clean['risk']=clean['strict_more_collisions']*25+clean['short']*20+clean['amb']*10
stable_df=clean[clean.book_key.isin(stable)].copy()
stable_df['appearance_count']=stable_df['book_key'].map(cnt)
# ranks in each sets
stable_df['in_initial']=stable_df.book_key.isin(init)
stable_df['in_relative']=stable_df.book_key.isin(rel)
stable_df['in_exposure_aware']=stable_df.book_key.isin(exp)
print(stable_df[['book_key','original_title','authors','appearance_count','early_title_key','early_key_count','strict_title_key','strict_key_count','strict_more_collisions','orig_len','short','author_count','amb','risk','in_initial','in_relative','in_exposure_aware']].sort_values(['risk','book_key'], ascending=[False,True]).to_string(index=False))
print('\\nstrict collisions groups around stable')
for _,r in stable_df.sort_values(['risk','book_key'], ascending=[False,True]).iterrows():
    if r.strict_key_count>1:
        peers=clean[clean.strict_title_key.eq(r.strict_title_key)][['book_key','original_title','authors','early_title_key','strict_title_key']].sort_values('book_key')
        print('\\nkey', r.strict_title_key, 'book', r.book_key, 'count', len(peers))
        print(peers.to_string(index=False))
PY"
